points.description: States that a steeper main stream/basin slope makes runoff flow faster and leave the catchment/basin quickly (higher velocity, quicker drainage).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says steep slope gives faster flow without linking to runoff leaving the basin, or vaguely stated.

points.description: Links this to time base: time base is the duration for runoff to leave the catchment after the storm, so quicker exit of runoff reduces (shortens) the time base.
points.partial_credit: Half if concludes time base is smaller without explaining/defining time base, or defines time base but does not link it to the steep slope.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for saying steeper slope makes runoff leave the basin quickly and therefore the time base (time for runoff to leave after the storm) is shorter. Give 1 mark where only one idea is given or both are vague, e.g. "steep slope gives faster flow so shorter hydrograph". Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers, such as saying steep slope lengthens the time base.
